title: ChatPanel
subtitle: Native ACP chat sidepanel (maude DS) — runs on your own Claude CLI subscription · idle/ready · streaming /design:edit · agent editing the canvas · not-connected explainer
brief: The phase-31 native ACP chat sidepanel (DDR-123): a right-docked chat panel where a developer drives Claude (/design:edit, /design:new, /design:critic, /design:screenshot) while watching the same canvas. Runs on the user's own installed claude CLI on their Pro/Max subscription — zero login in Maude, never API billing. Streaming + cancel + quick actions. An agent edit shows on the canvas like a live collaborator (LiveCollab --presence-agent treatment). Not-connected = a plain explainer, never an error.

sections.title: ChatPanel · maude
sections.subtitle: Native ACP chat sidepanel — runs on your own Claude CLI subscription · 4 artboards (phase-31 · DDR-123)

artboards.label: A · idle — ready to edit
artboards.note: Docked-right panel over a dotted workspace. Ready dot; empty-state (spark + 'Edit this canvas with Claude' + 3 real suggestion prompts incl. /design:critic & /design:new); the 4 persistent quick-actions; composer with an 'Editing: Login · Redesign' context chip, ⌘↵ hint, and 'your Claude subscription' footer.

artboards.label: B · streaming /design:edit + stop
artboards.note: A live edit streaming: user bubble (/design:edit …), assistant tool-call card (Edit Login.tsx, running dot, +/- diff lines) + streaming text with a violet caret. Composer swaps to a Stop bar (btn--danger + esc). Canvas frame shows the violet 'Claude is editing' badge.

artboards.label: C · the edit lands on the canvas
artboards.note: The agent-editing indicator (mirrors LiveCollab): the Login frame pulses in --presence-agent violet with a 'Claude is editing' badge + a violet 'Claude' cursor, while the chat shows the Edited tool-card (done, green) + 'a teammate in this draft saw it change live'. The signature moment: chat command → live canvas edit.

artboards.label: D · not connected — how to connect
artboards.note: Plain explainer (never an error): 'Claude Code isn't connected · run `claude` in a terminal'. A trust box encodes DDR-123 — runs on your Pro/Max subscription · no login inside Maude · never metered API billing. Composer disabled ('Connect Claude Code to start'); quick-actions disabled.
